mapper.select: select count(settlement_status) from team_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'
select sum(amount) from team_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'
select m.team_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id order by m.match_date desc

select m.team_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id where s.settlement_status = '정산대기' order by match_date desc

select m.team_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id and s.settlement_status = '지급완료' order by match_date desc

select m.team_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id where m.match_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by m.match_date desc

select m.team_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, u.nickname, u.account_holder, s.settlement_id, s.bank_name, s.account_number, s.amount, s.settlement_status from team_settlement s left join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id left join user u on s.user_id = u.user_id where s.team_match_id = #{teamMatchId}
select s.user_id, s.team_match_id, m.title from team_settlement s left join team_match m on s.team_match_id = m.team_match_id where s.settlement_id = #{settlementId}
